using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Entities;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Library;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Providers;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Entities;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace MediaBrowser.Controller.Entities.Tests
{
    public class VideoTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task RefreshMetadataForOwnedVideo_LogsInformation_WhenOrphanedVideoFound()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger<Video>>();
            var libraryManager = new Mock<ILibraryManager>();
            var videoId = Guid.NewGuid();
            var path = "/test/video.mp4";
            var options = new MetadataRefreshOptions();

            var orphanedVideo = new Mock<Video>();
            orphanedVideo.Setup(v => v.OwnerId).Returns(Guid.NewGuid());
            orphanedVideo.Setup(v => v.Id).Returns(videoId);

            libraryManager
                .Setup(lm => lm.GetNewItemId(path, typeof(Video)))
                .Returns(videoId);

            libraryManager
                .SetupSequence(lm => lm.GetItemById(videoId))
                .Returns((BaseItem)orphanedVideo.Object)
                .Returns((BaseItem)null);

            var video = new Video
            {
                Logger = logger.Object,
                LibraryManager = libraryManager.Object,
                Id = Guid.NewGuid()
            };

            // Act
            await video.RefreshMetadataForOwnedVideo(options, copyTitleMetadata: false, path, CancellationToken.None);

            // Assert
            logger.Verify(
                l => l.LogInformation("Owned video file no longer exists, removing orphaned item: {Path}", path),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task RefreshMetadataForOwnedVideo_DoesNotLog_WhenNoOrphanedVideoFound()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger<Video>>();
            var libraryManager = new Mock<ILibraryManager>();
            var videoId = Guid.NewGuid();
            var path = "/test/video.mp4";
            var options = new MetadataRefreshOptions();

            libraryManager
                .Setup(lm => lm.GetNewItemId(path, typeof(Video)))
                .Returns(videoId);

            libraryManager
                .Setup(lm => lm.GetItemById(videoId))
                .Returns((BaseItem)null);

            var video = new Video
            {
                Logger = logger.Object,
                LibraryManager = libraryManager.Object,
                Id = Guid.NewGuid()
            };

            // Act
            await video.RefreshMetadataForOwnedVideo(options, copyTitleMetadata: false, path, CancellationToken.None);

            // Assert
            logger.Verify(
                l => l.LogInformation(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object[]>()),
                Times.Never);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task RefreshMetadataForOwnedVideo_DoesNotLog_WhenOrphanedVideoDoesNotBelongToOwner()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger<Video>>();
            var libraryManager = new Mock<ILibraryManager>();
            var videoId = Guid.NewGuid();
            var path = "/test/video.mp4";
            var options = new MetadataRefreshOptions();

            var orphanedVideo = new Mock<Video>();
            var ownerId = Guid.NewGuid();
            var differentOwnerId = Guid.NewGuid();
            orphanedVideo.Setup(v => v.OwnerId).Returns(differentOwnerId);
            orphanedVideo.Setup(v => v.Id).Returns(videoId);

            libraryManager
                .Setup(lm => lm.GetNewItemId(path, typeof(Video)))
                .Returns(videoId);

            libraryManager
                .Setup(lm => lm.GetItemById(videoId))
                .Returns((BaseItem)orphanedVideo.Object);

            var video = new Video
            {
                Logger = logger.Object,
                LibraryManager = libraryManager.Object,
                Id = ownerId
            };

            // Act
            await video.RefreshMetadataForOwnedVideo(options, copyTitleMetadata: false, path, CancellationToken.None);

            // Assert
            logger.Verify(
                l => l.LogInformation("Owned video file no longer exists, removing orphaned item: {Path}", path),
                Times.Never);
        }
    }
}
